# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Context Monitor, please do NOT create a public issue.

Instead, please submit a report privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/bekirand/context-monitor/security/advisories/new) or contact the maintainer through GitHub. We take all reports seriously and will address them promptly.
